props.view_definition:
SELECT kinds.id,
    kinds.name
   FROM torture.kinds
  WHERE (kinds.status = 'paid'::torture.status);

SELECT kinds.status,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM torture.kinds
  GROUP BY kinds.status;

CREATE INDEX k_created_unused ON shop.customers USING btree (created)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_sku_key ON shop.products USING btree (sku)

CREATE INDEX k_status ON shop.orders USING btree (status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX kinds_pkey ON torture.kinds USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX parent_code_key ON torture.parent USING btree (code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX child_pkey ON torture.child USING btree (id)

PRIMARY KEY (id)

PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
UNIQUE (sku)
PRIMARY KEY (id)
PRIMARY KEY (id)
CHECK (((ratio >= (0)::double precision) AND (ratio <= (1)::double precision)))
UNIQUE (code)
PRIMARY KEY (id)

PRIMARY KEY (id)

PRIMARY KEY (k)
CHECK ((VALUE ~ '@'::citext))
CHECK ((VALUE >= (0)::numeric))

props.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_status BEFORE INSERT ON shop.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.default_status()
CREATE TRIGGER t_child_when BEFORE UPDATE ON torture.child FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.parent_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.parent_id)) EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE TRIGGER t_child_audit AFTER INSERT ON torture.child REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
